title: Zero-Trust Cold Pages (ZTCP): Accelerating Distributed RDMA KV-Cache Offloading via Fused Asymmetric Quantization and Authenticated Encryption
description: Official C++17 ARMv8.5-A FP16 NEON fused quantization + authenticated encryption (256-bit IETF RFC 8439 ChaCha20 + 128-bit SipHash-2-4-128 Encrypt-then-MAC) cold-page codec (26.65 +/- 0.46 GB/s hot / 10.00 +/- 0.17 GB/s wire egress and 25.84 +/- 0.28 GB/s hot ingress into preallocated CPU buffers across N=5 independent OS process runs), 32-byte AAD wire specification, reproducible benchmark suite, and paper for Zero-Trust Cold Pages (ZTCP) in distributed RDMA LLM serving (SGLang HiCache, vLLM/LMCache, Mooncake).
